# PKStack

Engineering workflows, repeatable checks, and project knowledge for Kiro.

Start with `/pkstack-setup` in the target workspace, then use `/poteto-kiro-mode <task>`.
Kiro owns native Specs, model choice, effort, permissions, and conversation state.
PKStack adds reusable development skills and a project-local verification runner.

Read the [usage guide](docs/usage.md), [first-task walkthrough](docs/first-task.md),
and [skill catalog](docs/curated-skills.md) for setup and examples.

This file supplies display metadata to the Kiro IDE 1.0.437 Power details view.
`plugin.json` remains the authoritative manifest and selects Agent Plugins loading;
Kiro-specific steering stays in `dev.kiro/steering/`.
